gotchas: Donation variants are digital: cart.js reports requires_shipping=false, so Shopify renders NO shipping-address and NO delivery-method step. Checkout is email + card only.

IMPORTANT — the digital/no-shipping shape does NOT avoid an out-of-band verification code. Observed 2026-08-25: filling the email field alone triggered a Shop account verification code delivered out-of-band to the shopper's phone (RCS Business Messaging, sender pattern shop_<id>_agent@rbm.goog, SMS fallback). skip_shop_pay=true in the redirect URL does NOT prevent this — that parameter only skips the accelerated Shop Pay checkout, not Shop account association from the email. Any agent filling an email that already has a Shop account should expect this on Shopify generally, not just here.
Whether the verification code is BLOCKING or merely offered alongside a guest path is unverified — the run stopped at the card step before that could be determined.

Variant 41901153484862 ('Ascot Hills Wildfire Resilience') is $1.00, the cheapest no-shipping variant on the store. A $0.00 'Processing Fees' variant also exists; do not use it, a zero total skips the card form.
The storefront is reachable as www.onetreeplanted.org but redirects to the bare apex during the cart-permalink hop.
Card fields are JS-injected — the card-fields-* iframes are absent from server-rendered HTML. Wait on iframe[name*=card-fields-number] before filling.
notes: US tree-planting nonprofit on Shopify. Route to the payment page and all selectors confirmed working 2026-08-25; card fill was not completed, so status is unverified rather than partial. Kept in the registry mainly for the email-triggers-Shop-verification finding above, which generalizes to the Shopify platform recipe.

overrides.addToCart: Skip the product page entirely. GET /cart/<variantId>:1 — on this store the permalink redirects straight through to /checkouts/cn/<token>/en-us?skip_shop_pay=true, landing ON the payment page in one navigation. No add-to-cart click, no /cart page, no 'Check out' button. Verified 2026-08-25.
